command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

echo "== verify the staged point cloud against its pinned sha256 =="
printf '%s  %s\n' 944b947501156e45df1b3b9d25bc1dc04ff5ef377e7e169576ba59231c2896ba autzen.laz > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256

echo "== PDAL: read header, then decode all points and compute a statistic =="
# autzen is PDAL's canonical reference cloud (documented 10,653,336 points). The header
# gives count + bounds (metadata); the Z-mean over every decoded point is the DECODE
# identity -- PDAL must LZ-decompress and apply scale/offset to all 10.6M points to
# reproduce it, which header integrity (and sha256) do not prove.
pdal info --summary /tmp/autzen.laz > summary.json 2>/dev/null
pdal info --stats --dimensions Z /tmp/autzen.laz > zstats.json 2>/dev/null

python3 - <<'EOF' > smoke-check.txt || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
import json,sys
s=json.load(open("summary.json"))["summary"]
z=json.load(open("zstats.json"))["stats"]["statistic"][0]
fail=[]
def check(l,ok,detail):
    print(f"{l:22s} {detail}")
    if not ok: fail.append(l)
cnt=s["num_points"]; b=s["bounds"]
# canonical documented count -- a reference identity, and the header value
check("point_count", cnt==10653336, f"{cnt}  want 10653336 (canonical autzen)")
# bounds (header metadata), exact
check("bounds_x", (round(b['minx'],2),round(b['maxx'],2))==(635577.79,639003.73), f"{round(b['minx'],2)}..{round(b['maxx'],2)}  want 635577.79..639003.73")
check("bounds_y", (round(b['miny'],2),round(b['maxy'],2))==(848882.15,853537.66), f"{round(b['miny'],2)}..{round(b['maxy'],2)}  want 848882.15..853537.66")
check("bounds_z", (round(b['minz'],2),round(b['maxz'],2))==(406.14,615.26), f"{round(b['minz'],2)}..{round(b['maxz'],2)}  want 406.14..615.26")
# decode identity: mean Z over ALL decoded points, and the stat pass saw every point
zc=int(z["count"]); zm=round(z["average"],4)
check("z_stat_count", zc==cnt, f"{zc}  want {cnt} (decoded every point; header==decode)")
check("z_mean_decode", abs(zm-434.1025)<1e-3, f"{zm}  want 434.1025 (mean Z over all points -- PDAL decode)")
if fail: print("FAILED: "+", ".join(fail)); sys.exit(1)
EOF
cat smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
